_comment: Everything the first run downloads, pinned in one place. Bump deliberately, then rebuild the fat artifacts so thin and fat stay identical.
_packageOverrides_comment: Per-platform package pins. Only for platforms where the normal pin does not exist. torch stopped shipping macOS x86_64 wheels after 2.2.2 and onnxruntime after 1.23.2, so an Intel Mac cannot install the versions everything else uses. EXPERIMENTAL: this is a different scanner stack from the one benchmarked, and is not shipped.
